name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Har Khet Ko Pani (Surface Scheme) Uttarakhand
benefit: Under this scheme, farmers are provided with free irrigation facilities. The following works are carried out to ensure irrigation support: - Pipelines / Gool (water channels) - Storage tanks / Geo-lined tanks - Solar pump sets - Small gated weirs
_eligibility_text: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must be a farmer engaged in agricultural activities. 1. As per the guidelines issued by the Government of India: - For the construction of collective irrigation schemes, clusters will be formed within a radius of 5 km from the proposed village, with a command area of 20 hectares or more. - In the case of an individual scheme, the command area should be 10 hectares or more. - The cost of the scheme must not exceed ₹4.00 lakh per hectare. - The benefit-cost ratio of the scheme must be greater than 1.0.
